sense: a section of an organization, with its own work

terms.gloss: a charge, someone’s department: the work assigned to them
terms.comment: Properly the task assigned to a magistrate; in comedy any job in someone’s charge, as in “that’s not my department”.

terms.gloss: the staff of an office; an administrative department
evidence: Dig. 1.18.6; Treb. Poll. Gall. 17.8: officia palātīna (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically a duty or a service.

terms.gloss: a faculty or department of a university
evidence: Traupman 302: litterārum classicārum facultās, department of classics
M-O s.v. department: major division of university

terms.comment: Classically an office or a service (Lewis & Short).

phrases.english: oh, Geta, that’s a hard job you’ve taken on

phrases.latin: quīn rūrī es in praefectūrā tuā? quīn potius quod lēgātum est tibi negōtium, id cūrās atque urbānīs rēbus tē apstinēs?
phrases.english: why aren’t you in the country at your own post? Why don’t you see to the business you were given, and keep out of town affairs?

sources: Lewis & Short: provincia · Lewis & Short: officium · Lewis & Short: facultas · Lewis & Short: ministerium
